LogText.DefaultText: Captain Reeve Sterling slashes at you with his sword!

AlternateLogTexts.DefaultText: The captain cuts at you with the sword!
The captain swings the sword at your head!

LogText.DefaultText: You fail to get clear and the sword connects...
You get out of the way in time...
Fortunately, the attack wasn't enough to hurt you.
The sword grazed you, leaving a shallow cut.
The sword nicked your flesh.
You suffered a small cut.
The sword bit into you, drawing blood.
The sword struck true and tore into your flesh.
You suffered a painful sword wound.
The sword cut you with brutal force.
The sword bites deep, leaving a terrible wound.
The captain presses forward with the sword, breathing hard!

AlternateLogTexts.DefaultText: The captain makes a tired swing with the sword.
The captain lunges clumsily with the sword.

Captain Sterling closes on you, sword drawn...
Captain Sterling goes down and does not get back up. You have killed the captain of the village Watch.
Captain Sterling breaks off, backs away with his sword still raised, and shouts for the Watch. He is beaten, but he is not dead.
You break away from Captain Sterling and run.
You have nothing left. You stop fighting and let Captain Sterling take you.

EventDescription.DefaultText: He is the captain of the village Watch, and he is standing in the open where anyone can see. Striking him is a crime whether you win or not.
